tspan.tspan: Finance Datamart External Data: 1f Monthly Datamart Cycle
: Dynamically Loaded on Working Day 2 to Working Day 10 on NSWXHOL Calendar
To Run this flow in NWUAT
Please run nw1fsynm to point Infa_nw synonyms to a
specific schema (i.e. DM, DM_PROJ) you want to update.
After you completed the FDM streams, run nw1fdpsy01 to
drop all Infa_nw synonyms for FDM tables.
